title: GL08 7-round AES-192 Related-key boomerang / one-byte recovery

target.description: Seven AES-192 nonlinear rounds; whitening and AK4 included, final round as Section4. The algorithm outputs only byte0 of the seventh-round subkey, eight bits, not the full192-bit master key.

setting.key_relation: Four unknown master keys Ka,Kb=Ka XOR DeltaK*,Kc=Ka XOR DeltaK-prime,Kd=Ka XOR DeltaK* XOR DeltaK-prime; source-defined master-key differences, no known key.
setting.plaintext_model: Adaptive chosen plaintext and ciphertext observations across the stated related unknown keys, using the source encryption and decryption oracles.
assumptions: Source approximates the AES S-box by equiprobable random-permutation transitions and assumes independent/identically distributed false-quartet filtering; not an exact AES-DDT or boomerang-compatibility proof.

data.note: Derived literally from Section4 Steps1–4: 2^49.5 structures times four oracles times2^16 queries each; small Step6 re-encryption queries excluded as source-negligible. Headline2^18 is per structure, not the aggregate.

memory.note: Four2^16-text structures held at a time; counters/filtered quartets additional source-negligible storage.

preprocessing.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

success.description: Source approximate0.8 for at-least-two correct-key quartets under a Poisson model with mean rounded from2^1.5 to3;8-bit subkey output only. Numerical values0.8008517 at mean3 and0.773718 at unrounded mean2^1.5 explain rounding, not two certified whole-attack successes.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.6–11 Section4, particularly pp.10–11 algorithm, aggregate query derivation, memory and Poisson success.
evidence.interpretation: Complete registered proceedings read and AES claim inventory checked2026-10-26; work-level gates remain open as specified in the audit receipt. Source claims and unresolved fields retain their original status.

limitations: The complete proceedings was read; nine-round full-version and later-primary access remain pending at work level. Seven-round total-data discrepancy and approximate quartet assumptions remain unresolved.
